children: RNS Number : 2762T  Church Commissioners for England  03 September 2026
Church Commissioners for England announces that Rosie Slater-Carr has been appointed as its new Chief Executive Officer, such appointment to take place with immediate effect.

This announcement may contain inside information for the purposes of Article 7 of the UK version of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 which is part of UK law by virtue of the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018, as amended.
